pick.headline: Four American churchwomen murdered in El Salvador
pick.summary: On 2 December 1980 four American churchwomen, three nuns and a lay missioner, were abducted and murdered by members of El Salvador's National Guard.
pick.significance: The killings caused President Carter to suspend aid to El Salvador briefly and made the Salvadoran military's abuses a lasting issue in Congress.

alternates.headline: Bush and Gorbachev meet off Malta
alternates.summary: On 2-3 December 1989 George Bush and Mikhail Gorbachev held their first summit aboard ships off Malta, weeks after the Berlin Wall opened.
alternates.significance: The Malta summit is often taken as the moment the two leaders declared the Cold War over.

alternates.headline: Pablo Escobar killed in Medellin
alternates.summary: On 2 December 1993 Colombian police tracked down and killed the Medellin cartel leader Pablo Escobar on a rooftop in Medellin.
alternates.significance: The hunt, assisted by US intelligence and special forces, ended the cartel's campaign of bombings against the Colombian state.
